meta.description: Linesman realism report: SYN-001 and 6 replicas against the DFL reference (guidelines v4, section 12)

reference.source: DFL/Sportec open data: Bassek, M., Rein, R., Weber, H., Memmert, D. (2025). An integrated dataset of spatiotemporal and event data in elite soccer. Scientific Data 12:195. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y. Licence: CC-BY 4.0. Aggregate statistics only; no raw, frame-level or person-level data.

rules.ks: one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance D = sup |F_syn(x) - F_dfl(x)|; F_dfl is the piecewise-linear CDF through the 21 DFL quantiles at meta.reference.quantile_levels_pct (atoms where quantiles repeat), 0 below the lowest and 1 from the highest; D is exact for that CDF (evaluated at every sample value and knot). The reference has no minimum or maximum (privacy), so against the full DFL distribution D can differ by at most 0.025 in the tails and by at most the largest spacing of two stored levels (0.05) between them
rules.median_rule: position of the synthetic median relative to the range (min-max) of the DFL per-match medians: inside, just_outside (within 10 % of the range width) or far_outside
rules.traffic_light: green = D <= 0.15 and median inside; yellow = D in (0.15, 0.3] or median just outside; red = D > 0.3 or median far outside. range_only metrics (one value per match or team-match) use the median rule only
rules.light_sample: the light of a metric uses the pooled synthetic sample (the match and its replicas); syn_match repeats the comparison for the match alone
rules.small_sample: ks_and_range metrics with fewer than 20 values on either side are indicative
rules.ks_d_noise95: diagnostic, not part of the light: the two-sample KS critical value 1.358 * sqrt((n + m) / (n m)), the D that two samples of these sizes from the same distribution exceed only 5 % of the time (per-frame samples are autocorrelated: their real chance level is higher)

shots_diagnostic.note: label = the outcome label (simulation or provider annotation, R-SHOT-COUNTS); observed = the pipeline's outcome from the trajectory (R-SHOT-OUTCOME, R-WOODWORK). A label 'woodwork' observed otherwise is a woodwork hit the pipeline does not recognise; woodwork_shots gives the nearest approach of the ball samples to the woodwork.
